title: The Repair Shop's Second Business
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・実証結果ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A fictional company produces small household appliances and earns most of its revenue by selling new models.
sentences.ja: 架空の企業は小型家電を製造し新製品の販売で収益の大半を得る。

sentences.en: A group of employees proposes establishing a repair service for customers whose products no longer function properly.
sentences.ja: 正常に動かなくなった製品の顧客向け修理サービスを設ける案を従業員が出す。

sentences.en: The manager initially fears that providing affordable repairs might reduce the demand for replacement products.
sentences.ja: 管理者は当初安価な修理が買い替え製品の需要を減らすかもしれないと恐れる。

sentences.en: However, the employees argue that the proposal should be evaluated in relation to the company's long-term relationship with its customers.
sentences.ja: しかし企業と顧客の長期的関係に照らし提案を評価すべきだと従業員は主張する。

sentences.en: The team identifies several financial consequences that might follow from introducing the service.
sentences.ja: サービス導入に伴い得る複数の財務的影響を特定する。

sentences.en: Repairing a product requires trained technicians, an adequate supply of replacement components, and a system for arranging appointments.
sentences.ja: 修理には訓練された技術者、交換部品の十分な供給、予約を調整する仕組みが必要だ。

sentences.en: At the same time, a reliable service might encourage customers to choose the company's products when they eventually need to replace an appliance.
sentences.ja: 同時に信頼できるサービスなら、やがて家電を買い替える顧客が同社製品を選ぶ理由になるかもしれない。

sentences.en: The team acknowledges that neither possibility has been established by simply proposing a new business model.
sentences.ja: 新事業モデルを提案しただけではいずれの可能性も実証されないと認める。

sentences.en: Rather than expanding immediately, the company develops a limited trial covering several products for which replacement parts remain available.
sentences.ja: 直ちに拡大せず交換部品のある数製品を対象とした限定試行を作る。

sentences.en: Employees record the time and materials required for each fictional repair and examine the difficulties customers encounter when requesting assistance.
sentences.ja: 架空の修理ごとに時間と材料を記録し顧客が支援を求める際の困難を調べる。

sentences.en: They also distinguish repairs that can be completed efficiently from those that require resources disproportionate to the value of the appliance.
sentences.ja: 効率よく終えられる修理と家電の価値に不釣り合いな資源を要する修理を区別する。

sentences.en: The trial is designed to reveal relevant costs and operational constraints rather than guarantee a profitable outcome.
sentences.ja: 試行は利益を保証するのでなく関連費用と運用制約を明らかにするよう設計される。

sentences.en: During a discussion of the proposed service, another employee suggests considering how product design influences the difficulty of future repairs.
sentences.ja: サービスの議論中、製品設計が将来の修理の難しさにどう影響するか考える案が出る。

sentences.en: A component that is difficult to remove may increase the time required by a technician even if the component itself is relatively inexpensive.
sentences.ja: 外しにくい部品はそれ自体が比較的安価でも技術者の作業時間を増やし得る。

sentences.en: The company therefore begins to examine whether decisions made during manufacturing might create additional expenses later in the product's life.
sentences.ja: 製造時の判断が製品寿命の後半に追加費用を生むか検討し始める。

sentences.en: This broader perspective connects decisions about initial production with questions that arise after a customer has purchased the product.
sentences.ja: 広い視点は初期製造の判断と購入後に生じる問いを結びつける。

sentences.en: The imaginary example illustrates how a business model can influence which aspects of a product's life receive attention.
sentences.ja: 仮想例は事業モデルが製品寿命のどの側面に注意が向くかに影響し得ると示す。

sentences.en: Selling more items may be a useful objective, but it does not necessarily capture every source of value available to a company or its customers.
sentences.ja: 販売数増は有用な目標でも企業や顧客にとっての全価値を捉えるとは限らない。

sentences.en: A repair service should be judged in relation to its actual costs, benefits, and the conditions needed to sustain it.
sentences.ja: 修理サービスは実際の費用、利益、維持に必要な条件との関係で評価すべきだ。

sentences.en: The challenge is to investigate whether a different way of serving customers can create value without assuming in advance that every alternative will succeed.
sentences.ja: 課題はどの別案も成功すると事前に想定せず、別の顧客支援が価値を生むか検討することだ。
